name: Upsert a Company in Attio
description: Creates or updates a company record in Attio CRM by matching on domain. If a company with the given domain exists, their record is updated; otherwise a new company is created.

domain.description: Company domain (e.g., 'acme.com') used as the matching attribute

steps.name: Build the values payload for the company record
Assert (upsert) the company record via Attio API
